label: same execution toggles
script:
shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s
" "$?"; shopt -s dotglob; shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s
" "$?"; shopt -u dotglob; shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s
" "$?"

label: function shares state
script: enable() { shopt -s dotglob; }; enable; shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s\n" "$?"

label: subshell clone inherits without writeback
script: shopt -s dotglob; (shopt -q dotglob; printf "child:%s\n" "$?"; shopt -u dotglob); shopt -q dotglob; printf "parent:%s\n" "$?"

label: substitution clone inherits without writeback
script: shopt -s dotglob; saved=$(shopt -q dotglob; printf '%s' "$?"; shopt -u dotglob); printf '%s\n' "$saved"; shopt -q dotglob; printf '%s\n' "$?"

label: pipeline stage clone inherits without writeback
script: shopt -s dotglob; { shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s\n" "$?"; shopt -u dotglob; } | cat; shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s\n" "$?"

label: new interpreter process resets off
script: shopt -s dotglob; bash -c 'shopt -q dotglob; printf "child:%s\n" "$?"'; shopt -q dotglob; printf "parent:%s\n" "$?"

label: new interpreter process resets off
script: shopt -s dotglob; sh -c 'shopt -q dotglob; printf "child:%s\n" "$?"'; shopt -q dotglob; printf "parent:%s\n" "$?"

label: reusable listing round trip
script: saved=$(shopt -p); shopt -s dotglob; eval "$saved"; shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s\n" "$?"

label: ordinary builtin function precedence and command bypass
script:
shopt() { printf "function
"; return 7; }; shopt -s dotglob; printf "%s
" "$?"; command shopt -s dotglob; command shopt -q dotglob; printf "%s
" "$?"
